messages:
maria: OK team — quick sketch for a 'cascade' rollout model for multi-zone routing + tenant isolation. intent: incremental, reversible, observable. high level phases below, want feedback on launch criteria and customer gating.

ash: +1. can you list the phases? small bullets please. :eyes:

devin: i like incremental. also want a clear definition of 'isolation' per phase (network, compute, control plane).

maria: phase 0 = pilot tenants on a single soft-affinity lane (no hard quota). validate prefix cache effectiveness and routing decisions.

samir: phase 0 launch criteria: 24h stable perf for pilot tenants, p99 < target, zero regressions on model outputs (smoke evals). also basic telemetry for routing decisions.

ash: phase 1 = affinity lanes by tenant groups. still shared capacity but routing prefers local zone, ability to override for capacity.

liz: phase 1 criteria: autoscaler behaves under 3x normal load, KV cache hit rate >= 60% for affinity traffic, rollout rollback tested with canary.

devin: need a concrete failure / rollback playbook for phase 1. what happens if latency spikes? who slices? @eng-oncall-bot required?

maria: agreed. add a runbook step: immediate circuit to global pool if latency > threshold for 5m, notify eng-oncall and product.

samir: phase 2 = isolated slices: reserved vGPU pools per slice, egress controls, and tenancy quotas. good for high-SLA customers.

ash: phase 2 criteria: defined capacity commit, SLA contract tests (99.9% availability for 30d in test), per-tenant cost leak checks. also validate KMS/HSM integration for private tenants.

liz: need migration tools for tenants moving from shared -> slice. windows, data movement, pinning model versions. suggest a migration api like:
```
POST /v1/tenants/{id}/migrate
{ "target_slice": "slice-42", "dry_run": true }
```

maria: perfect. dry-run must produce a compatibility report (model variant check, quantization profile, perf delta).

devin: phase 3 = full private deploy (VPC/on-prem) option; product sales-led. launch criteria: ops runbook, support SRE handoff, compliance audit complete.

samir: prioritization note: tag customers by compliance need and revenue. phase 2 owners = enterprise sales/CS to nominate early slices.

ash: can we quantify the acceptance metrics? propose:
- p99 latency within 1.2x of baseline for 95% of tenants
- error budget burn <= 10% in a 7d window post-launch
- migration success rate >= 99% dry-run -> live

liz: add QA: set of prompts + eval harness for output parity pre/post migration, with human-review threshold for regressions.

maria: operational constraints: network egress policies, cross-region fallbacks, and cost guardrails (auto-evict lower-priority tenants when cost/slot pressure > X). need product decision on eviction max frequency.

devin: suggest eviction cap = 1 evict per tenant per 24h by default; enterprise CUAs can request exemptions.

samir: telemetry: must record routing decision trace per request (reason code: affinity|quota|fallback), cache hits, queue delay, selected kernel/quantization. store for 7d at min.

ash: rollout timeline suggestion: Q1 pilot, Q2 affinity lanes, Q3 slices, Q4 private offers. flexible depending on early pilot learnings.

liz: risks: model-aware routing complexity, increased ops surface, customer confusion. mitigation: clear tagging in console and a migration dashboard.

maria: next actions: 1) product to finalize customers for pilots (samir/liz) 2) eng to produce runbook and test harness (devin/ash) 3) SRE to validate fallback policies and quotas (samir)

devin: i'll stub a minimal test harness this week and add a perf job.

ash: i'll write the canary/rollback playbook and a small RFC for eviction policy.

samir: i'll coordinate customer selection and legal checks for any pilot customers.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: architecture sync meeting on 2024-06-12 16:00 UTC — thread pinned. :calendar:

maria: thanks all. will turn this into a short RFC and link the pilot list. :shipit:
